content.short: A unique NFT project of cute dragons that helps encourage holding ADA.
content.description:
Dragon Caves are a unique Cardano NFT collection of 5550 cute, colorful and playful classic cartoon style dragon NFTs with a project set to make NFT utility more fun than average.

The Dragon NFTs are using a slow marketplace release, through jpg store, instead of a typical website mint. This allows one out of every ten holders to win a rare NFT through a giveaway and one out of every fifty holders to win a legendary ultra rare NFT through another giveaway.

50 Dragon Cave NFTs are released every time a total of 5 sales takes place until all 5550 are dropped. This means their will be 5000 NFTs listed for sale in total over time, and that 550 giveaways of rare NFTs and ultra rare NFTs will take place. Please see the website for more details.

Dragon Caves features a unique type of self custodial staking that we call "protect your gold". It allows holders to earn ADA based on their wallet Cardano holdings, increases in those holdings and decreases in those holdings.

There are plans to make a chose your own adventure text based game to allow additional ADA earnings as well as tokens known as dragon scales.
